steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0010_stage2_safeguarded_training branch from main and initialize step tracker.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0008_tts_eval_harness_baselines and t0009_stage2_training_failure_forensics are completed.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create task folder structure, populate aggregator cache.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: no new literature needed; approach is fully specified from t0009 forensics findings.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: all required knowledge comes from prior tasks t0008 and t0009; no external research needed.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0009 safeguard library (train_second_safeguarded.py, health_gates, jsonl_logger, checkpoint_manager, run_config) and t0008 tts_eval_harness to understand interfaces for implementation.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design the v10 training config (joint_epoch=8, epochs_2nd=20), VM deployment plan, evaluation strategy, and asset packaging plan.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Start LLM-T1-NC80 H100 VM, verify GPU, deploy idle watchdog, copy safeguard code and configs.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Run train_second_safeguarded.py with config_david_v10.yml, evaluate per-epoch checkpoints with tts_eval_harness, collect JSONL metrics and checkpoint manifests.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Stop LLM-T1-NC80, download all results, update costs.json and remote_machines_used.json.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: single-variable controlled experiment; approach is fully defined by t0009 root-cause findings.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json with per-epoch speaker_sim curve, best checkpoint analysis, and health gate report.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare achieved speaker_sim against published StyleTTS2 and ElevenLabs baselines from the paper corpus.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Generate follow-up task suggestions based on training results, speaker_sim trajectory, and health gate events.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture session transcripts, finalize task.json status.
